description:
Census tract of a US street address with the designations lenders and tax-credit programs use: the 11-digit
        tract GEOID (2020 boundaries), the FFIEC 2026 tract income level (low / moderate / middle / upper, from the tract
        median family income as a percent of the metro or statewide nonmetro median; low and moderate = LMI tract for
        CRA), HUD Qualified Census Tract status for 2026 and 2027, HUD Difficult Development Area status (by ZIP Code
        Tabulation Area in metro areas, by county outside them), and Opportunity Zone status. Read from the official lists;
        a point near a tract boundary can fall in the neighbouring tract, so confirm with the agency before relying on it.
name: census_tract_lookup
